artifacts.notes: The content-delivery route https://www.vatican.va/content/dam/wss/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_decree_19651207_ad-gentes_en.html returned a byte-identical 122003-byte response with this SHA-256 on 2026-07-24; the press route returned HTTP 404 and is not recorded as an alias. The response contains the complete numbered English body and chapter-separated notes but no promulgation or subscription block. Delivered defects include article 1's unclosed quotation and «overseer: of the ages»; article 2's «His life and His cry» where the Latin has vita et gloria; article 4's «Acts of the Apostles took again», omitted note marker 9, and malformed «a giving life, soul-like»; article 5's «disciples of a nations»; article 7's «1 Tim. 2:45» for 1 Timothy 2:4-6; recurrent Lumen gentium labels that point to Dei Verbum; recurrent Rerum Ecclesiae labels that point to Ex corde Ecclesiae; and note 24's corruption of Augustine, De civitate Dei 19.17 as «St. Augustine 7, City of God, 1917». This records known source-local defects without claiming an exhaustive diplomatic collation. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.

passages.context: The complete English article was inspected for Christ's sending of the Holy Spirit, Pentecost's public manifestation of the Church, the Gospel's spread among the nations, the Spirit's hierarchical and charismatic gifts, ecclesial unity, and missionary impulse.
passages.notes: The delivered defects in the Acts sentence, missing note marker, and «a giving life, soul-like» phrase are recorded at artifact level and are not silently quoted as corrected English. The article does not by itself establish the Spirit's divinity or the complete doctrine of procession and sanctification, and its many source notes do not become direct evidence for a consumer.

passages.context: The complete English article was inspected for Christ as the one mediator and way of salvation, God's possible leading of those inculpably ignorant of the Gospel by ways known to him, the Church's sacred duty to evangelize, and missionary activity's continuing force and necessity.
passages.notes: The delivered «1 Tim. 2:45» citation defect is recorded at artifact level. This passage preserves both the inculpable-ignorance qualification and the necessity of mission; it does not adjudicate an individual's salvation or provide a complete theology of religions.
